name: Aurochs
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Passive Perception 11. Languages none. Proficiency Bonus +2.
appearance: A broad, muscular wild bovine with a thick neck and long, outward-pointing horns.

sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, first printing, p. 71, Cattle, Aurochs.
sections.Actions: Gore. Make a +7 melee weapon attack against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage. If the aurochs moved at least 20 ft. straight toward the target immediately before the hit, it deals another 9 (2d8) piercing damage. A creature hit after that movement must succeed on a DC 15 Strength save or fall prone.
sections.Encounter ecology: Aurochs roam in wild herds. Orcs and humans sometimes train them from an early age to carry riders in combat.

name: Deep Rothé
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 10. Languages none. Proficiency Bonus +2.
appearance: A shaggy Underdark bovine with thick curled horns and a low, compact build.

sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, first printing, p. 71, Cattle, Deep Rothé.
sections.Traits: Beast of Burden. Count the creature as one size larger when determining its carrying capacity.
sections.Actions:
Gore. Make a +6 melee weapon attack against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the rothé moved at least 20 ft. straight toward the target immediately before the hit, add 7 (2d6) piercing damage.
Dancing Lights. The rothé casts dancing lights using Wisdom as its spellcasting ability. The casting requires no components.
sections.Encounter ecology: Deep rothé communicate with others of their kind using dancing lights.

name: Dolphin
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Blindsight 60 ft. Passive Perception 13. Languages none. Proficiency Bonus +2.
appearance: A sleek dolphin with a tapered beak, curved dorsal fin and streamlined gray body.

sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, first printing, p. 97, Dolphins, Dolphin.
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The dolphin can hold its breath for 20 minutes.
sections.Actions: Slam. Make a +4 melee weapon attack against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the dolphin moved at least 30 ft. straight toward the target immediately before the hit, add 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Encounter ecology: Dolphins are social marine mammals about 5 to 6 ft. long as adults. They hunt small fish and squid in oceans and the Elemental Plane of Water.

name: Ox
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
otherStatistics: Passive Perception 10. Languages none. Proficiency Bonus +2.
appearance: A heavy domesticated bovine with a broad body, strong shoulders and long curved horns.

sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, first printing, p. 72, Cattle, Ox.
sections.Traits: Beast of Burden. Count the creature as one size larger when determining its carrying capacity.
sections.Actions: Gore. Make a +6 melee weapon attack against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the ox moved at least 20 ft. straight toward the target immediately before the hit, add 7 (2d6) piercing damage.
sections.Encounter ecology: Oxen are domesticated cattle raised for hauling and for milk or meat.
